name: DigitalTrialsID
description: Generate digital research participant ID cards for Apple Wallet and Google Wallet.

project-settings.name: Study Title
project-settings.description: Enter the study title exactly as it should appear on the digital participant ID.

project-settings.name: Principal Investigator Name
project-settings.description: Enter the principal investigator's name exactly as it should appear on the digital participant ID.

project-settings.name: Study Contact Email
project-settings.description: Enter the study contact email address displayed on the digital participant ID.

project-settings.name: Study Description
project-settings.description: Enter a brief, participant-friendly description of the study purpose or objective.

project-settings.name: Study Contact Phone Number
project-settings.description: Optional. Enter a telephone number participants or healthcare providers may use to contact the study team.

project-settings.name: Participant Name Field
project-settings.description: Select the REDCap text field containing the participant name displayed on the digital ID.

project-settings.name: Study Start Date Field
project-settings.description: Select the REDCap date field containing the participant's study start date.

project-settings.name: Study End Date Field
project-settings.description: Optional. Select the REDCap date field containing the participant's study end date. Leave this unselected if the end date may be unknown.

project-settings.name: Google Wallet Link Field
project-settings.description: Select the REDCap text field where the generated Google Wallet link should be saved.

project-settings.name: Apple Wallet Link Field
project-settings.description: Select the REDCap text field where the generated Apple Wallet link should be saved.

project-settings.name: Instrument That Issues Digital Study IDs
project-settings.description: Select the REDCap instrument that should generate the Apple Wallet and Google Wallet links when saved.

system-settings.name: Environment
system-settings.description: Identifies the environment used when generating Google Wallet object identifiers.

system-settings.name: Google Service Account Key (JSON)
system-settings.description: Paste the complete JSON credentials for the Google service account authorized to issue Wallet objects. Treat this value as a sensitive credential.

system-settings.name: Google Issuer ID
system-settings.description: Enter the institution's Google Wallet Issuer ID.

system-settings.name: Google Wallet Class ID Suffix
system-settings.description: Enter only the Generic Pass class suffix, such as digitaltrials_class. The issuer ID is added automatically.

system-settings.name: Apple Wallet Token Secret
system-settings.description: Enter the shared secret used to sign Apple Wallet JWT tokens. It must match the secret configured in the Apple Wallet pass-generation service.

system-settings.name: Apple Wallet Endpoint URL
system-settings.description: Enter the HTTPS URL for the Apple Wallet pass-generation service.

system-settings.name: Google Wallet Logo URL
system-settings.description: Optional. Enter a direct HTTPS URL to a logo image accessible to Google Wallet.

system-settings.name: Google Wallet Hero Image URL
system-settings.description: Optional. Enter a direct HTTPS URL to a hero image accessible to Google Wallet.

system-settings.name: Google Wallet Card Background Color
system-settings.description: Optional. Enter a hexadecimal color value, such as #004080.
